title: System overview

panels.title: API-equivalent cost per day (UTC)

targets.queryText: select cast(strftime('%s', day) as integer) as time, cost_usd as "cost" from cost_per_day where cast(strftime('%s', day) as integer) between $__from/1000-86400 and $__to/1000 order by day
targets.rawQueryText: select cast(strftime('%s', day) as integer) as time, cost_usd as "cost" from cost_per_day where cast(strftime('%s', day) as integer) between $__from/1000-86400 and $__to/1000 order by day

panels.description: Status line cost_usd summed by day. Not a bill: an estimate at pay-as-you-go API prices; the subscription is a flat fee.

panels.title: Fresh tokens per workspace per day (input + output + cache writes)

targets.queryText: select ts/86400*86400 as time, case when cwd = '/home/purplg/claude' then 'manager' when cwd like '/home/purplg/claude/%' then substr(substr(cwd, 21), 1, instr(substr(cwd, 21) || '/', '/') - 1) else 'other' end as workspace, sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens) as tokens from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1, 2 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/86400*86400 as time, case when cwd = '/home/purplg/claude' then 'manager' when cwd like '/home/purplg/claude/%' then substr(substr(cwd, 21), 1, instr(substr(cwd, 21) || '/', '/') - 1) else 'other' end as workspace, sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens) as tokens from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.description: Workspace is the directory under ~/claude of the message's cwd; the Manager's own directory is 'manager', anything outside ~/claude 'other'. Days are UTC.

panels.title: Repository size over time

targets.queryText: select ts as time, repo, size_kib * 1024 as bytes from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 order by ts
targets.rawQueryText: select ts as time, repo, size_kib * 1024 as bytes from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 order by ts

panels.description: Loose plus packed objects of each bare clone, sampled after every maintenance run.

panels.title: Loose objects and packs

targets.queryText: select time, sum(loose) as "Loose objects", sum(packs) as "Packs" from (select ts/3600*3600 as time, repo, loose, packs, max(ts) from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1, 2) group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select time, sum(loose) as "Loose objects", sum(packs) as "Packs" from (select ts/3600*3600 as time, repo, loose, packs, max(ts) from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1, 2) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Summed over the bare clones; gc drops the loose objects and merges the packs.

panels.title: Maintenance run duration

targets.queryText: select ts as time, repo, duration_ms from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 order by ts
targets.rawQueryText: select ts as time, repo, duration_ms from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 order by ts

panels.description: Wall time of each git maintenance run, per repository.

panels.title: Failed maintenance runs per day (UTC)

targets.queryText: select ts/86400*86400 as time, sum(1 - ok) as failed, count(*) as runs from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/86400*86400 as time, sum(1 - ok) as failed, count(*) as runs from maint_runs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Runs where git maintenance exited non-zero, next to all runs of the day.

description: Cost and tokens next to the upkeep of the bare clones.
